## About
Sweeney's Custom Mufflers is a family owned auto shop on Sepulveda Blvd in Torrance. We work on foreign and domestic cars, light trucks, SUVs and mini-vans, with catalytic converters and exhaust as our specialty, plus brakes, struts and shocks, electrical and engine work.
Bring in a rattle, a reroute or a new aftermarket exhaust and Verne will talk it through with you. One customer watched the whole job on his classic car and was asked how he wanted the tips placed.
We're rated 4.7 from 102 Google reviews. Give us a call or stop by the shop.

## Services
- Catalytic converter replacement and installation: Stainless steel aftermarket and OEM converters, weld-in or bolt-in, that are EPA and CARB approved. We are authorized installers of Miller, Walker, Magnaflow, Catco and Cartex.
- Custom muffler work: Quality custom jobs for aftermarket muffler setups. One customer brought in his classic car with a FlowMaster muffler and chrome double tip and was consulted on how to finish the tip placement.
- Smog check: One customer said the crew was polite and quick, and he got in and out without an appointment.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Foreign and domestic cars, light trucks, SUVs and mini-vans.

Q: Will a new catalytic converter be legal in California?
A: Yes. All of our catalytic converters are EPA and CARB approved and are made for your specific vehicle.

Q: Can I come in after work?
A: Evening appointments are available. Give us a call to set one up.
